content:
tara(sec): Auditor Sam asked for a minimal evidence bundle: RBAC change workflow -> SOC2/ISO crosswalk, KMS rotation + unwrap events for last 24 months, and proof that service-account permission changes were reviewed. Can we scope artifacts and an ETA? @ben @olivia

ben(infra): Scope ack. Deliverables: 1) one-page control map linking steps to SOC2 CC6 / ISO A.9.x, 2) list of RBAC PRs with reviewer history, 3) rolebinding diffs + CI smoke test logs, 4) KMS metadata exports (no key material), 5) signed attestation for any manual unwraps. ETA 36 hours for full bundle.

olivia(eng): For CI proof I'll include a job snippet that runs our policy check:
```
# ci excerpt
kubectl apply -f test/rolebinding-check.yaml --dry-run=server
kubectl auth can-i create pods --as=system:serviceaccount:team:deploy:ci
```
I'll add `git log --pretty=oneline -- cluster/roles/` and a sample `git diff` showing the role change.

auditor_sam: Please make sure KMS exports show CreateDate, RotationStatus, any ReEncrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey calls and the approver identity for manual ops. Redaction OK if you include a redaction-map under NDA. Also need a one-paragraph attestation for manual unwrapping.

tara(sec): I'll write the attestation and GPG-sign it. Note: do NOT include key material. We'll replace ARNs with internal ids like `user:1023` in exported JSONs and provide `redaction-map.csv` for auditor use.

ben(infra): Splunk query I'll run for KMS events: `index=cloudtrail eventSource=kms.amazonaws.com (eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey OR eventName=ReEncrypt*) | table _time userIdentity.arn eventName requestParameters` I'll export both gzipped JSON for the bundle and a CSV summary for quick review.

olivia(eng): On service-account changes: required approvers are `team-lead` + `sec-oncall` enforced by branch protection. I'll include PR links and a redacted screenshot of the review history (no private comments).

a(pkg-bot): pkg: prepackage checksums generated (run id: ev-2140000001-01). Expected files: control-map.md, rbac-prs.csv, role-diffs/, kms-events.json.gz, attestations/attestation-signed.txt, redaction-map.csv.

ben(infra): Packaging plan: upload `evidence-2140000001.tar.gz` to s3://audit-evidence/2140000001/ with `manifest.txt` listing SHA256s. I'll post a presigned link when upload completes.

auditor_sam: ETA 36h works. Please include a short vuln-triage note if any KMS-related packages were patched in that window (one paragraph with PR link). Drop presigned link here when ready and I'll begin review. :thumbsup:

tara(sec): Thanks team I'll review manifest before upload and sign the attestation. Ping if anything blocks.
